push.title: W 7-6 vs CD CHlVAS | You: 10.0 (Perfect Game #8)
push.body:
Ten. Point. Zero. BellyTb1, that's a Perfect Game #8 and I'd like it laminated, please.

THE GOOD
+ A perfect 10.0, your 8th Perfect Game for us. That's the reliable kind of good.
+ 6 shots at CD CHlVAS's goal. The more you shoot, the luckier you get.
+ 3 key passes (up from your usual 1). Somebody's gonna owe you dinner for those passes.
+ Man of the Match, your 21st for us. You were the best player on the pitch, and you know it. Now stay humble.
+ You and PhogsToffees turned simple passes into goals.

THE BAD
- Lowest tackles attempted on the team: 2 (best was Soup_Kitchen22's 7). We need more from you there, and I know you've got it.
- Their humans averaged 41 completed passes; you had 23. Not who you are, but it was who showed up.
- Shots on target: 67%. Steady. Elite forwards get to 90%+.

Training ground: Track your runner all the way into the box. Most goals against come from late, unmarked runs.

BellyTb1, one more thing before you log off: Quiet feet, loud heart.

Keep that up and I'll have to start buying bigger biscuit tins. - Coach Lasso

+ 2 key passes. You found gaps I didn't know were there, and I was looking.
+ Tackle success 40%, up from your usual 16%. Proof you've got another gear.

+ Your 5th best match performance of the season (9.9). Keep stacking those.

- 3 of 5 shots on target. Start here: Tight angle? Cut it back to a teammate. A better shot beats a first shot. That's the whole secret.

Remember, PhogsToffees: Confidence is a muscle. Today you got a rep in.

Stay humble, stay hungry. - Coach Lasso

weaknesses.title: Tackle timing
tips: Delay, deny, then dictate. Jockey goal-side and only commit when their touch gets heavy.
Every missed tackle leaves a runner free behind you. If you're not sure, contain and let cover arrive.
Stay on your feet. Slide only when you're certain of the ball and there's somebody behind you.

Soup_Kitchen22, a 5.6 against CD CHlVAS, your worst match performance of the season. Rough one. Be a goldfish, keep the lesson.

THE GOOD
+ Tackles attempted 7, up from your usual 3. Proof you've got another gear.
+ On-ball actions 22, up from your usual 15. Keep that in your back pocket.
+ Shots 2, up from your usual 1. Write that one down and stick it on the fridge.

THE BAD
- Missed tackles 7, up from your usual 2. Quick fix: Win it with your body before your foot: shoulder to shoulder, then poke it away.
- 62% passing (8 of 13, up from your usual 55%). Little adjustment: Open your hips to the field when you receive. Side-on body shape turns a back pass into a forward one. Mind over matter.
- 1 of 2 shots on target. Homework: Hit the target first, beat the keeper second. A shot on target can still be saved into a rebound.
- Red card. Tiny tweak: No slide tackles from behind or as the last defender. A red card costs us the whole match. You'll thank me later.
- PhogsToffees had the same shot selection trouble. Team up on it: cut it back to each other.

THE UGLY
! Their best forward posted 10.0 to your 5.6. Ugly is the right word. Not the only word, but the right one.
! Red card: the team played a player down for the rest of it. I've seen tidier yard sales. Simple as pie: If you're beaten, sprint the recovery run goal-side instead of reaching in.

Practice plan: Scan before the ball gets to you - a quick shoulder check means you already know the pass before you need it.

Hey, Soup_Kitchen22. The ball is round, the game is long, and you're doing just fine.

You're closer than you think. - Coach Lasso
